tensura-reference/mobs/mobs-army-wasp.md.summary: A Flower Forest predator with Lethal Poison attacks and a 10,000–15,000 EP range.

tensura-reference/mobs/mobs-goblin.md.summary: A village-spawning trader that can be named into a Hobgoblin; it does not restock trades.

tensura-reference/biomes/biomes-ancient-.summary: A high-magicule forest surrounding the Spirit Tree, with rare plants, spirits, and giant-tree portals.

tensura-reference/biomes/biomes-barren-l.summary: A stark, high-magicule wasteland with increased Magic Ore generation and no listed creature spawns.

tensura-reference/biomes/biomes-desert-o.summary: A lethal desert without ordinary animal spawns, inhabited by the biome's strongest hostile creatures.

tensura-reference/biomes/biomes-miasmic-.summary: An undead-filled plain where ancient Wizard Towers can appear and sunlight no longer restrains undead spawns.

tensura-reference/structures/structures-.summary: A savanna and forest nest populated by Giant Ants, with branching chambers beneath the surface.
A red-sand Underworld ruin with buried treasure pockets, suspicious sand, and hostile Hound Dog and Megalodon spawns.
A mountain settlement where Dwarves live and the Training Ground houses a Battlewill Master.
A compact Underworld Sands ruin with suspicious sand or gravel, explorer-map loot, and hostile local spawns.
A rare Overworld cave where a Charybdis encounter can be summoned through its core.
A forest settlement populated by Goblins, with a chief house that can contain the Short Sword Schematic.
A rare gate that can appear in several Overworld biomes and the Underworld, guarded by hostile local creatures.
An Ancient Forest landmark that serves as the entrance to the Labyrinth and houses an Elemental Colossus.
A swamp settlement populated by Lizardmen and Hover Lizards, with a blacksmith that can hold a Spear Schematic.
A web-filled nest populated by Black Spiders, with chests containing web gear, bows, eggs, and other loot.
A rare elemental tower whose biome variant determines which magic tomes can be found inside.

tensura-reference/blocks/blocks-block-of.summary: The solid block form of Adamantite, the late-stage material reached after High Magisteel equipment progression.
A consolidated High Magisteel material block represented by its verified upstream game texture.
The solid block form of Hihi'Irokane, a high-tier material used across advanced equipment progression.
A consolidated Low Magisteel material block represented by its verified upstream game texture.
A compressed Magic Ore block that the source documents as refining into two Pure Magisteel Ingots.
The solid block form of Mithril, one of Tensura's equipment and crafting materials.
The solid block form of Orichalcum, an advanced material used in high-tier equipment progression.
A Pure Magisteel material block that can be used to revive the Elemental Colossus.
The block form of Raw Silver obtained from the mod's Silver Ore family.
The refined block form of Silver, a material associated with holy equipment properties.

tensura-reference/blocks/blocks-chilled-.summary: A chilled variant of the Slime resource block, shown with its verified upstream game texture.

tensura-reference/blocks/blocks-charybdi.summary: A boss-summoning core found in Charybdis Cave that must absorb 100,000 EP from nearby kills before activation.

tensura-reference/blocks/blocks-high-qua.summary: The high-quality tier of the consolidated Magic Crystal block family.

tensura-reference/blocks/blocks-low-qual.summary: The low-quality tier of the consolidated Magic Crystal block family.

tensura-reference/blocks/blocks-medium-q.summary: The medium-quality tier of the consolidated Magic Crystal block family.

tensura-reference/blocks/blocks-kiln.md.summary: A processing station that smelts Magic Ore Shards into Molten Magisteel for further material refinement.

tensura-reference/blocks/blocks-magic-en.summary: An activatable machine that lowers ambient Magicules in a configurable 16-block radius and can suppress mob spawning.

tensura-reference/blocks/blocks-magic-or.summary: A rare ore whose deepslate variant is concentrated near Y -27 and drops Magic Ore Shards when mined with the required tool.

tensura-reference/blocks/blocks-moth-egg.summary: A placed egg block associated with Tensura's Moth creature; the source does not document a normal acquisition route.

tensura-reference/blocks/blocks-palm-log.summary: The bark-sided log from Tensura's Palm wood set and its matching construction family.

tensura-reference/blocks/blocks-palm-woo.summary: The all-bark wood block from Tensura's Palm construction set.

tensura-reference/blocks/blocks-slime-ch.summary: The block form of Slime Chunks, represented with its verified upstream game texture.

tensura-reference/blocks/blocks-smithing.summary: Tensura's specialist crafting station for schematic-unlocked armor, weapons, tools, and other gear.

tensura-reference/blocks/blocks-silver-o.summary: The ore source for Raw Silver; its regular and deepslate variants require different minimum pickaxe tiers.

mysticism-reference/blocks/blocks-ice-or.summary: Mysticism's Ice Essence ore, documented for cold-biome generation in the pinned 1.21.1 build.

tensura-reference/blocks/underworld-barr.summary: A 104,000-density Underworld terrain block associated with Daemon and Hound Dog territory.

tensura-reference/blocks/underworld-red-.summary: A 102,000-density red Underworld sand found around Big Ruins and hostile local spawns.

tensura-reference/blocks/underworld-sand.summary: A 101,000-density Underworld sand used around Ruins and hostile local spawns.

tensura-reference/blocks/underworld-spik.summary: A 103,000-density spiked Underworld terrain block associated with Daemon territory.
